scope: Offline synthetic photo-on-canvas tests; no official simulator, ROS transport or Gazebo run.

protocol.split: One lexicographically first available file per real class; remaining distinct hashes held out.
protocol.reference_replay: Same photograph as the registered template, resampled onto a plain dark canvas; not generalization.
protocol.perturbations: 3 draws each: perspective corner jitter +/-12%; width 170..460px with height cap 320px; brightness alpha .35..1.35 beta 0..35; combined.
protocol.centering: True center is the projective image of the source surface center, not the average of corners.
protocol.timing: perf_counter around detect_targets only; includes normalization and all 7 reference comparisons, excludes image loading/warping.
protocol.limitations: Only 12 third-party images, 5 held-out photos, single target, plain background, no blur/occlusion/video. Perturbations are correlated repeats, not additional independent photos. No tuning or improvement claim.
